title: Posting Payer Remittances and Modeling Underpayments — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Policy clause.** Each payer remittance on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) is posted line by line: the payment as a payer payment, the CO-45 contractual obligation as a contractual adjustment, and each PR line (PR-1 deductible, PR-2 coinsurance, PR-3 copay, PR-204 non-covered, PR-27 coverage terminated) as a patient-responsibility release to the patient's account (or as a secondary crossover when a next payer exists). The payer-allowed amount of a remittance is its payment plus its patient-responsibility lines. Because balance billing is prohibited, the patient is never billed more than the PR lines the payer reported, and a contractual amount is never moved to the patient. Riverbend models the expected allowed amount as the payer class's expected allowed percentage of the billed charges; when the allowed amount falls short of the expected allowed amount by at least the payer class's USD underpayment threshold and by at least its percentage underpayment threshold of the expected allowed amount, the claim is routed for an underpayment appeal. A payer must pay or deny a clean claim within the clean-claim period. The claim closes when its payer balance reaches zero.

**Modeling figures.** The expected allowed amount is the claim's billed charges multiplied by the expected allowed percentage, divided by 100 and rounded to the cent. The variance floor is the higher of the USD threshold and the expected allowed amount multiplied by the percentage threshold divided by 100, rounded to the cent; a shortfall at or above the variance floor meets both thresholds.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures).** Billed charges 10,000.00 at a modeled 50%: expected allowed 5,000.00. With a 25.00 USD threshold and a 2% threshold, the percentage figure is 100.00, so the variance floor is 100.00. An allowed amount of 4,880.00 (shortfall 120.00) is routed for an underpayment appeal; 4,920.00 (shortfall 80.00) is not.

| Remittance line | Posted as |
|---|---|
| payment | payer payment |
| CO-45 | contractual adjustment, never moved to the patient |
| PR-1, PR-2, PR-3, PR-204, PR-27 | patient-responsibility release, or secondary crossover when a next payer exists |
